versions.subject: add comcvcs.dll memdump method
versions.detection:
rundll_image:
    Image: '*\rundll32.exe'
rundll_ofn:
    OriginalFileName: 'RUNDLL32.EXE'
selection:
    CommandLine:
        - '*comsvcs*MiniDump*full*'
        - '*comsvcs*MiniDumpW*full*'
condition: (rundll_image or rundll_ofn) and selection

versions.subject: Update win_susp_comsvcs_procdump.yml
versions.detection:
rundll_image:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
rundll_ofn:
    OriginalFileName: 'RUNDLL32.EXE'
selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'comsvcs'
        - 'MiniDump' #Matches MiniDump and MinidumpW
        - 'full'
condition: (rundll_image or rundll_ofn) and selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\rundll32.exe" OR OriginalFileName="RUNDLL32.EXE" CommandLine="*comsvcs*" CommandLine="*MiniDump*" CommandLine="*full*"
